NGA.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports Nigeria launched GovGuideNigeria, an AI platform giving real-time conversational answers on immigration procedures, documents and public programmes via WhatsApp and the web in English, Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba.
ITWeb Africa says GovGuideNigeria consolidates information from more than 35 federal ministries and over 60 government agencies.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy

NGA.note: GovGuideNigeria is a general information chatbot, not a sector system.
Says only that it was developed with NCAIR, Meta and Publica AI; no model, dataset or compute is stated as built or hosted in the country.
No rural internet programme or rural-urban figure is stated.
Built with NCAIR, Meta and Publica AI; the document does not say government staff built or run it.
No startup law, labelling or fund is stated.
No hub, incubator or park is described.
